description:
T1. Ash Tree	Rear Garden:

Carry out an aerial climbing Inspection to assess the condition of stems, unions, 
and limbs supported by the bracing
Inspect the remainder of the crown for cracks, splits, decay, cavities, or dysfunctional wood
Remove dead branches throughout the crown area that are over 2.5cm in diameter.

Inspection of COBRA Tree Bracing Systems

The current condition and performance of the COBRA bracing system.
The condition of the supported tree parts
Whether the bracing system remains appropriate, safe, and effective.

Report any adverse findings, and recommendations made are advisory and based on 
on the tree’s condition at the time of inspection. 

The tree's current height is 17m, and its crown spread is 15m
After the proposed works, the tree's height is 17m, and the crown spread is 15m.

 
T2. Yew Tree	Rear Garden:

Reduce the height by 2.5m and lateral spread by up to 2m, providing a natural rounded form.

The tree's current height is 9m, and its crown spread is 6m
After the proposed works, the tree's height is 6.5m, and the crown spread is 4m.
